title: Get closer to the game with Gemini and Pixel
summary: Gemini and Pixel have announced new long-term partnerships with Arsenal FC, FC Barcelona, FC Bayern München, Liverpool FC, and Paris Saint-Germain to bring fans closer to the game through AI personal intelligence and smartphone technology.
